snippet.title: Drive Beyond Horizons | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The world of Drive Beyond Horizons is revealed for the very first time.

Explore a vast and immersive open world where driving, survival, and discovery come together in a unique adventure experience. Push beyond the horizon, uncover unknown regions, and prepare for a journey shaped by exploration and freedom.

🚗 Open world driving experience
🌍 Exploration-focused gameplay
⚙️ Vehicle progression and survival systems
🔓 A mysterious world waiting to be discovered

This is the official announcement of Drive Beyond Horizons, introducing the game’s vision and core experience for the very first time.
